isim_sehir.blurb: Write together, first one done calls STOP
howTo: When the letter lands, fill every category at once
First done calls STOP and answers open
Shared answers score 10, unique ones 20; you can object

xox.blurb: Line up three, take the round
howTo: With 2 players, take turns on a classic board
With 4 or 8, a tournament bracket is set up
Line up three marks (or your board's win length) to win

synked.blurb: Think the same word, match within 4 rounds
howTo: In 2p, write a private seed and associate until you match
In 4p, teams lock seeds with STOP, then race
First team to match the same word wins

wordle.blurb: Follow the clues, catch the hidden word
howTo: Try to guess the hidden word
Green is right place, yellow is right letter wrong place
Find it before the round ends
Hide your ships on the board
Take turns firing at their grid
Sink the whole fleet to win

tabu.blurb: Describe it without the banned words
howTo: Describe the card word to your team
Don't say the banned words
Score as many as you can before time is up
Roll the dice and move your pieces
Cut rivals and race to safety
First to bring all pieces home wins
